introText: Our Q3 2026 focus expands AG Charts with new timeline and quadrant chart types, smarter series label collision avoidance for dense data, broader event callbacks, and more flexible multi-chart synchronisation — adding more chart types, deeper integration, and a more polished experience.

items.title: Server-Side Rendering
items.why: Expands AG Charts into reporting, exports, and backend workflows where charts must be generated outside the browser.
items.desc: Render charts on the server and in non-DOM environments, producing output without a live browser.

items.title: Chart Navigation Improvements
items.why: Supports data-heavy applications with more intuitive and stable navigation.
items.desc: Smoother chart exploration with a scrollbar, range buttons, and refined real-time update interactions.

items.title: Richer Bar Chart Customisation
items.why: Supports more advanced and in-demand bar visualisation use cases.
items.desc: Overlay bar series to compare values against targets, set fixed-width bars, and skip null values.

items.title: Focus State API
items.why: Improves responsiveness within interactive applications and eases integration into larger apps.
items.desc: A programmatic API to consume and control tooltip and highlight focus state.

items.title: Server-Side Data Loading
items.why: Supports larger datasets and more flexible data architectures.
items.desc: Asynchronous, developer-controlled data loading that fetches only the data in view as users zoom and pan.

items.title: Data Point Selection
items.why: Enables richer application interactions and deeper integration in enterprise applications.
items.desc: Select individual data points and respond to selection within the host application.

items.title: Improved Theming
items.why: Delivers consistent cross-product UX and intergration with enterprise design systems.
items.desc: Expanded theming controls and CSS variables.

items.title: Organisation Chart
items.why: Expands AG Charts into HR, reporting, and hierarchical data use cases.
items.desc: A new organisation chart series for visualising hierarchical data.

items.title: Colour Scale
items.why: Supports more expressive and data-driven reporting experiences.
items.desc: A unified colour scale for mapping values to colours across heatmap, treemap, and other series.

items.title: Icons and Images in Labels
items.why: Supports more expressive and branded reporting experiences.
items.desc: Embed icons and images within chart labels.

items.title: Series Label Collision Avoidance
items.why: Maintains label legibility in high-volume, data-dense charts.
items.desc: Automatically detect and resolve overlapping series labels for cleaner presentation of dense data.

items.title: Additional Event Callbacks
items.why: Enables host applications to respond to a wider range of chart interactions and user actions.
items.desc: Broader event coverage with additional callbacks across chart interactions.

items.title: Quadrant Chart
items.why: Expands AG Charts into analytical and data-comparison use cases.
items.desc: A new quadrant chart for comparing items across two dimensions.

items.title: Validation Feedback
items.why: Helps developers configure charts correctly from the outset, including when working with AI coding assistants.
items.desc: Stronger dev-time validation of chart options, with clearer errors and control of warning levels.

items.title: Accessibility Improvements
items.why: Supports compliance and inclusive design for enterprise and public-sector applications.
items.desc: Improved keyboard navigation and screen reader support, with greater control over accessibility behaviour.

items.title: Additional Financial Series Types
items.why: Delivers the most in-demand series types for financial and trading applications.
items.desc: Additional financial and trading chart series types.

items.title: New Annotation Tools
items.why: Enables more precise and expressive annotation for end users in trading and analytical applications.
items.desc: New annotation types with precise placement, axis labels, and magnet snapping.

items.title: Financial Chart Customisation
items.why: Gives developers greater control to build bespoke financial and trading applications.
items.desc: Custom user series, configurable axis types, and status bar control for the financial chart.

items.title: AI Coding Skill
items.why: Supports developers using AI coding assistants, keeping generated code aligned with the latest AG Charts APIs.
items.desc: A lightweight, installable skill that gives AI coding assistants up-to-date guidance for building with AG Charts.
